items.title: Entergy Q3 Earnings Top Estimates, Revenues Increase Year Over Year
items.summary: ETR beats Q3 earnings and revenue estimates as strong electricity demand, favorable weather and regulatory rate actions drive growth, while higher costs pressure results.

items.title: PEG Q3 Earnings Miss Expectations, Revenues Decrease Y/Y
items.summary: PEG's Q3 2026 earnings and revenues miss estimates amid declining operating income and rising costs despite higher sales volumes and nuclear generation.

items.title: Dominion Energy's Q3 Earnings Top Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
items.summary: D's Q3 earnings rise 20.8% and beat estimates by 6.7%, while revenues increase 24.1% and surpass expectations by 17%, driven by strong utility performance.

items.title: Edison International Q3 Earnings Outpace Estimates, Revenues Miss
items.summary: EIX's Q3 earnings decline 17.9% but beat estimates by 4.9%, while revenues fall 15% and miss expectations by 11.7%.

items.title: IDACORP Q3 Earnings & Revenues Outpace Estimates, '26 EPS View Raised
items.summary: IDA beats Q3 2026 earnings and revenue estimates, fueled by higher Idaho base rates and customer growth, and raises its full-year earnings guidance.

items.title: Xcel Energy Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
items.summary: XEL's Q3 2026 earnings and revenues beat estimates, driven by higher electric sales and favorable weather, as the company lowers its 2026 EPS outlook.

items.title: CMS Energy CEO predicts data center ‘progress’ after midterms
items.summary: Garrick Rochow blamed political “spin” for permitting setbacks in an earnings call. He did not address the more than $300 million the utility says it has spent to keep an aging coal plant running under DOE ‘emergency’ orders.

items.title: CMS Energy (CMS) Stock Faces Q3 Earnings Margin Crunch
items.summary: CMS Energy came into this Q3 2026 report with a premium P/E of 25.1x and a stock that had already climbed about 9.6% over the past month. The new earnings print landed with less excitement, as the share price slipped 0.85% to about US$69 in the first full day of trading after the release. The headline story is profit pressure.
